site_name: Land bounded by Elder Street, Folgate Street, Blossom Street, Norton Folgate, Shoreditch High Street and Commercial Street, E1
description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/14/03548, Dated 03/05/2016Non Material amendment(s) Sought: Amendment to the description of development from:Redevelopment of the former Nicholls and Clarke urban block and adjoining former depot site, Loom Court and land and buildings north of Fleur de Lis Passage and Fleur de Lis Street, including retention and refurbishment of buildings, for commercially led mixed use purposes comprising buildings of between 4 and 14 storeys to provide B1 (office), A1 (retail), A3 (restaurants and caf‚s), A4 (public house) and 40 residential units; together with new public open spaces and landscaping, new pedestrian accesses, works to the public highway and public realm, the provision of off-street parking, and all necessary ancillary and enabling works, plant and equipment.To:Redevelopment of the former Nicholls and Clarke urban block and adjoining former depot site, Loom Court and land and buildings north of Fleur de Lis Passage and Fleur de Lis Street, including retention and refurbishment of buildings, for commercially led mixed use purposes comprising buildings of between 4 and 14 storeys to provide B1 (office), A1 (retail), A3 (restaurants and caf‚s), public house (Sui Generis) or drinking establishment with expanded food provision (Sui Generis) and 40 residential units; together with new public open spaces and landscaping, new pedestrian accesses, works to the public highway and public realm, the provision of off-street parking, and all necessary ancillary and enabling works, plant and equipment'; and  Amendment to the wording of Condition 6 in relation to the updated Ground Floor Plan showing the amalgamation of the units.
